title: Dense Clinical Contrasts Enhance Medical Knowledge Updating in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.30405v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Medical knowledge changes continually, making large language models vulnerable to relying on outdated yet clinically plausible information. We study whether the format of supervision affects medical knowledge updating under a matched training-budget setting. We introduce SEER-Bench, a temporally anchored oncology-staging benchmark curated from the latest versioned SEER Research Data release, and render identical medical update events from NCCN oncology guidelines into four supervision formats: EMQ, MSQ, FITB, and SAQ. Across SEER-Bench and HealthBench Professional, EMQ gives the most stable external transfer and retention among same-budget SFT variants. With EMQ supervision, the updated 4B model produces competitive results on temporally anchored oncology staging, reaching 64.8% answer accuracy and 59.6% rationale accuracy on SEER-Bench. translated_title: 密集临床对比增强大语言模型中的医学知识更新
translated_abstract: 医学知识持续变化，使得大语言模型容易依赖过时但看似合理的临床信息。我们研究了在匹配训练预算的设置下，监督数据的格式是否会影响医学知识更新。我们引入了SEER-Bench，这是一个基于最新版本化SEER研究数据发布整理的时间锚定肿瘤学分期的基准，并将来自NCCN肿瘤学指南的相同医学更新事件渲染为四种监督格式：EMQ、MSQ、FITB和SAQ。在SEER-Bench和HealthBench Professional上，在相同预算的SFT变体中，EMQ提供了最稳定的外部迁移和知识保留能力。在EMQ监督下，更新后的4B模型在时间锚定的肿瘤学分期任务上取得了有竞争力的结果，在SEER-Bench上达到64.8%的答案准确率和59.6%的理由准确率。诊断分析表明，EMQ在保持判别性的同时暴露出更密集的临床对比信号。
tldr: 在相同训练预算下，提供密集临床对比信号的EMQ监督格式最能促进大语言模型的医学知识更新，更新后的4B模型在SEER-Bench肿瘤学分期上达到64.8%的答案准确率和59.6%的理由准确率。
en_tdlr: Under matched training budgets, EMQ supervision with denser clinical contrast signals most effectively updates medical knowledge in large language models, with the updated 4B model achieving 64.8% answer accuracy and 59.6% rationale accuracy on temporally anchored oncology staging in SEER-Bench.
